promotions.behavior: Central rankings service accepts metric updates only from the catalog-defined owner and produces deterministic permission-filtered snapshots.
assumptions: This proves Reforged coordination behavior, not the existence or exact behavior of Classic MajorMUD rankings.
promotions.safeFallback: Reject unknown rankings, owner mismatches, unauthenticated queries, and hidden subjects.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Provides a single read-model boundary for scoreboards without duplicating source metric formulas.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: None directly; Character and other metric owners retain authoritative values.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Optional ranking snapshots and reset metadata are coordinated through world persistence.

promotions.behavior: Ranking ties and ordering are deterministic and privacy restrictions are applied before projection.
assumptions: Competition ranking is a Reforged-safe policy until native tie behavior is recovered.
promotions.safeFallback: Use canonical subject IDs for stable ordering and omit unauthorized entries.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents unstable or privacy-leaking leaderboard output.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Ranking revisions change only when accepted metric mutations occur.

promotions.behavior: Scheduled or manual ranking resets are explicit policy and require administrative authorization for direct reset.
assumptions: Clock scheduling dispatches reset requests but does not own ranking state.
promotions.safeFallback: Disable resets for Never policy and reject unauthorized manual reset.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Establishes reset ownership without inventing native schedules.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Clears projected ranking entries and records reset time and revision.
